_comment: The per-primitive stim_mode vocabulary. Fully-resolved mirror of dataset_gen/logic/autosweep/sweep_spec.POWER_MODES (arithmetic-only modules resolve to the default ['random']). A (primitive, mode) pair not listed here is unpredictable and the loader rejects any projection that uses it. New modes are added in POWER_MODES + the module TB template first, then here. See docs/COMPOUND_SCHEMA.md §1 and dataset_gen/logic/autosweep/activity_modes.md.
